Per catalog action, the REST routes, in the live GitLab record's spelling, and the GraphQL operations its handler can send, each classified by the paths that make it: mandatory on every path, an alternative on some, optional on none. Each request carries the classic scope GitLab requires for it, and each action the one its least demanding way of running needs, beside the scopes its catalog group demands. Where a request comes from is named by symbol, never by line, so a change to a handler shows here as a change to what it sends.
